raw_segments.text: Again, on the same supposition, the man who acting on conviction pursues and chooses
things because they are pleasant must be thought a better man than he who does so not by reason
of a quasi-rational conviction, but of imperfect self-control, because he is more open to cure
by reason of the possibility of his receiving a contrary conviction.
